Outline of astronomy
The following
outline
is provided as an overview of and topical guide to astronomy:
Astronomy
– studies the
universe
beyond Earth, including its
formation and development
, and the evolution,
physics
,
chemistry
,
meteorology
, and
motion
of
celestial objects
(such as
galaxies
,
planets
, etc.) and
phenomena
that originate outside the
atmosphere of Earth
(such as the
cosmic background radiation
). Astronomy also intersects with biology, as
astrobiology
, studying potential life throughout the universe.
